xbox_app.title: Presence — Xbox App Registration
xbox_app.description:
To connect Xbox Live, you need a free Azure AD app:

1. Go to **https://portal.azure.com** and sign in with your Microsoft account
2. Search for **App registrations** → **New registration**
3. Name: anything (e.g. `HA Gaming Hub`) — Supported account types: **Personal Microsoft accounts only**
4. Click **Register**
5. Go to **Authentication** → enable **Allow public client flows**
6. Copy the **Application (client) ID** and paste it below

Leave the field blank and check Skip to configure Xbox later.

xbox.title: Presence — Xbox Authentication
xbox.description:
Go to **{verification_uri}** and enter the code: **{user_code}**

Then click Submit to check authorization (expires in {expires_in}s).

Check 'Skip' to configure Xbox later.
